documents.text:
Cedar evaluation policy HR-42: annual leave.
Employees receive 20 annual leave days per year.

Cedar evaluation policy HR-420: parental leave.
Employees receive 16 weeks of parental leave after a birth or adoption.

Cedar evaluation policy HR-43: training reimbursement.
Training reimbursement is capped at 1200 demo credits per calendar year.

Cedar evaluation policy IT-105: help desk hours.
The help desk operates Monday through Friday from 9 AM to 6 PM.

Cedar evaluation policy IT-1050: device replacement.
Company laptops are replaced every four years after asset team approval.

Cedar evaluation policy SEC-17: lost access badge.
A lost access badge must be reported to building security within one hour.

Cedar evaluation policy SEC-170: visitor escort.
Visitors must remain with their employee host while inside the laboratory.

Cedar evaluation policy FIN-28: travel receipts.
Travel expense receipts must be submitted within 30 days of the trip ending.

Cedar evaluation policy FIN-280: meal allowance.
The meal allowance for overnight business travel is 45 demo credits per day.

Cedar evaluation policy OPS-64: equipment booking.
Shared projectors can be reserved up to seven days before a meeting.

Cedar evaluation policy OPS-640: parcel collection.
Incoming parcels must be collected from reception within three business days.

Cedar evaluation policy ENG-91: release approval.
A production release requires approval from the on-call engineer and the service owner.
